questions.prompt: Who is responsible for the rights to a likeness in a Runway reference image?

options.text: You are, as Runway says you are responsible for rights to any likeness you submit
options.explanation: Right. Runway also says to use only references of people you have permission to depict.

options.text: Runway, because its tool checks every reference for rights before you can use it
options.explanation: The page puts the responsibility on the person who submits the reference.

options.text: Nobody, if the reference is a photo of a model who works for the studio
options.explanation: The page applies to any likeness you submit.

questions.prompt: What does Anthropic say about the expiry setting on an uploaded file?

options.text: It deletes the file's content for good at the exact moment of expiry
options.explanation: Anthropic says content may be kept for a limited period for safety review.

options.text: It is a lifecycle feature, not a guaranteed-deletion control
options.explanation: Right. To remove a file before its scheduled expiry, you use DELETE.

options.text: It can be changed later, in case the licence is renewed
options.explanation: Anthropic says expiration is set once at upload and cannot be changed.

questions.prompt: How can an uploaded OpenAI file be removed automatically?

options.explanation: Right. OpenAI's data controls page says files can be deleted by hand or automatically with expires_after.

options.text: OpenAI deletes every file after 24 hours
options.explanation: The table lists application state for /v1/files as until deleted.

options.text: By renaming the file with a date
options.explanation: A file name has no effect on how long the file is kept.
